macroForm.help.activationRoles: When a macro starts, it runs for every assigned role that is launched and controllable. At least one role must be available; unavailable roles are skipped.
macroForm.help.activationShortcutSources: Shortcut source roles only start the macro. They do not become execution roles or receive macro steps.
macroForm.help.activationModes: Tap to toggle switches between starting and stopping. With Tap or hold, a tap completes at least one run, while holding keeps a looping macro active until release.
macroForm.help.activationRepeat: A loop waits and starts its next run only after the full step sequence finishes. A 0 ms interval removes only the extra wait; input timing and browser scheduling still apply.
macroForm.help.callsRequirements: A called macro uses its own assigned roles. Every called macro must be enabled and assigned, and macro calls cannot form a cycle.
macroForm.help.callsWait: Wait for completion runs the child macro once and resumes the parent after it finishes. Keys held until stopped are released at the end of that run.
macroForm.help.callsTrigger: Trigger and continue uses the child macro's repeat setting without making the parent wait. Interrupting the parent stops its triggered descendants; when the parent completes normally, they continue running.
macroForm.help.callsDuplicate: Triggering a child macro that is already running does not start or create another run.
macroForm.help.stopRun: Timed holds release automatically when their duration ends. Stopping or cancelling a macro releases both timed holds and keys held until stopped.
macroForm.help.stopChild: Stopping a child in Wait for completion cancels the parent. Stopping a Trigger and continue child does not stop the parent.
macroForm.help.stopRole: Closing any participating role stops the entire multi-role macro run and its descendants that are still owned by it.

settings.aboutLegalDescription: Review app identity, legal documents, privacy practices, and third-party software notices.

settings.diagnosticsDescription: Inspect local application activity and export a privacy-safe diagnostic bundle.
settings.performanceDiagnosticsDescripti: Measures requestAnimationFrame timing and graphics availability in every visible role on the active game tab. The latest result is included in diagnostic exports.
settings.performanceDiagnosticsHint: Measurement starts in 1.5 seconds. Switch to the game window you want to test and keep it focused until sampling finishes.
settings.performanceDiagnosticsNoRunning: No running role is available to measure. Launch a role or workspace, then try again.
settings.performanceDiagnosticsNoVisible: Running roles were found, but no visible game window was available.
settings.performanceDiagnosticsFindingFa: This surface could not be sampled; inspect the error below and the exported logs.
settings.performanceDiagnosticsFindingHi: The page was not visible during sampling, so background throttling can lower its animation rate.
settings.performanceDiagnosticsFindingUn: The page was visible but not focused. Repeat the measurement while this game viewport has focus.
settings.performanceDiagnosticsFindingMa: macOS Low Power Mode is enabled and can reduce the display update rate. Turn it off before comparing foreground FPS.
settings.performanceDiagnosticsFindingWi: Windows Battery Saver is enabled and can reduce graphics performance. Turn it off before comparing foreground FPS.
settings.performanceDiagnosticsFindingTh: System thermal pressure is {state}. Let the device cool before treating this sample as a page or GPU regression.
settings.performanceDiagnosticsFindingHi: The macOS high-refresh preference was not applied ({status}). Restart Rion Studio and inspect the exported logs if the status persists.
The macOS high-refresh preference is disabled. Enable it in browser settings, then restart Rion Studio before measuring again.
settings.performanceDiagnosticsFindingLo: Detected {count} JavaScript long task(s); the longest blocked the page for {longest} ms. Profile game or injected script work on the main thread first.
settings.performanceDiagnosticsFindingFr: Detected approximately {count} missed display refresh(es). Frame pacing is unstable even if average FPS appears acceptable.
settings.performanceDiagnosticsFindingIn: The page was sampled, but the display refresh rate or a stable rAF rate could not be resolved.
settings.performanceDiagnosticsFindingBe: Observed {fps} FPS on a {hz} Hz display. Focus and visibility are healthy, so page workload, compositor/GPU load, or an engine limit is the likely next area to inspect.
settings.performanceDiagnosticsFindingNe: Observed rAF timing is close to the display refresh rate; no foreground frame-rate cap is evident in this sample.
